hey, im working on a paper for my international relations class. can u help me out? i need an analysis of how effective current US border security policies actually are when you look at them through the lens of national sovereignty and economic stability. thanks!

US border security policies present a complex trade-off between asserting national sovereignty and supporting economic stability. Policies aimed at strict control can strongly reinforce the state's right to control its borders, a core aspect of sovereignty. However, aggressive enforcement can also create significant economic strain through human capital loss or the need for increased defense spending, challenging overall stability. Therefore, the "effectiveness" is highly debatable, depending on whether the focus is on absolute political control or predictable, stable national function.
